Since the tangent passes through $(3, -8)$ then
$$\begin{aligned} -8 &= 6a - a^2 - 1 \\ a^2 - 6a - 7 &= 0 \\ (a-7)(a+1) &= 0 \\ a = 7,&\quad a = -1 \end{aligned}$$
$\therefore$ The equations of the two tangents are

$$\begin{aligned} y &= 2(7)x - 7^2 - 1 \\ y &= 14x - 50 \end{aligned}$$
and when $a = -1$,
$$\begin{aligned} y &= 2(-1)x - (-1)^2 - 1 \\ y &= -2x - 2 \end{aligned}$$

solutions.latex:
$$r + r^2 + \cdots + r^n = 1$$
Sum of GP with $a = r$, common ratio $= r$, number of terms $= n$
$$\begin{aligned} \therefore\ \dfrac{r\left(r^n - 1\right)}{r - 1} &= 1 \\ r^{n+1} - r &= r - 1 \\ r^{n+1} &= 2r - 1 \qquad (*) \end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned} E(X) &= \sum xP(X = x) \\ &= r\times r^n + r^2\times r^{n-1} + \cdots + r^n\times r \\ &= r^{n+1} + r^{n+1} + \cdots + r^{n+1} \\ &= r^{n+1}\times n \\ &= nr^{n+1} \\ &= n(2r - 1) \qquad \text{from } (*) \end{aligned}$$
